subtitle: Enter the bell valley.
briefing: The valley’s houses stand dark and empty. A bell sounds somewhere beyond the fog.
hints: Keep sight of one another in the fog.

victory.speaker: The company
victory.text: The Bellwarden falls. The sound above the courtyard breaks into a thin, wavering note, then dies.

victory.speaker: Captain Nera
victory.text: Gather anyone still alive. We’re leaving.

debrief: The bell is silent. The company withdraws from the valley with the survivors.
